items.title: Template engine injection (BlockStrap)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability allowing unauthenticated remote code execution through template engine injection. Adobe fixed it in the October 2026 security update, but a manual patch is required, and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability with a CVSS score of 10.0 that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution. Adobe released an emergency hotfix, and it has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) that allows an unauthenticated attacker to gain elevated access to sensitive resources without user interaction. This flaw has been actively exploited and was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of Dangerous File Type (PolyShell)
items.summary: A critical unrestricted file upload vulnerability (CVSS 9.3) that allows attackers to upload disguised image files containing PHP code through guest cart APIs. This vulnerability has been actively exploited, with hundreds of stores breached.
